title: 净化战线（异净特遣队）
description:
Welcome to Doomsday Cleaning Company!

【Recruit Powerful Characters & Off-Game Progression】To ensure commanders can fight at their best, we’ve contacted many reclusive masters. Spend your Human Resources to recruit and enhance them all!

【Satisfying Combat Experience】

Unleash endless firepower on the battlefield! Switch characters and use skills at any moment – the battlefield is yours to command!

【Adventure & Grow in Diverse Scenarios】

Meet charming merchants, encounter quirky events and storylines, and claim rich rewards! Keep growing stronger through innovative roguelike tower-climbing gameplay!
description_short: Purification Frontline is a post-apocalyptic roguelite bullet-hell action shooter. Build your squad, switch characters in battle, collect relics, and carve your way through branching tower runs with fast-paced combat and explosive firepower.
